title: Using the Tecan Infinite M200 Pro for Symbiodiniaceae Growth Estimates
author: Samantha R Coy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkpqkvmw
materials: Tecan Infinite M200 Pro plate reader
Once the software has loaded, select 2 or 3 wells that you wish to measure by clicking and dragging across the schematic on the software. Only these wells should be highlighted yellow now.

steps.title: Power on the Plate Reader
steps.instruction: Turn on the Tecan Infinite M200 Pro plate reader using the switch on the back of the box.

substeps.instruction: Verify the green light is on or electronic dialogue appears to confirm both components are powered.

steps.title: Launch Control Software
steps.instruction: Open the 'i-control 1.11 (for infinite reader)' software from the computer desktop and wait for the 96-well plate schematic to appear.

steps.title: Configure Fluorescence Settings
steps.instruction: Set the excitation and emission wavelengths for Symbiodiniaceae measurement.

substeps.instruction: Double-click 'Fluorescence intensity' in the left sidebar.
Set excitation wavelength to 488nm (blue light).
Set emission wavelength to 685nm (red fluorescence).

steps.title: Adjust Instrument Parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the remaining default settings in the software.

substeps.instruction: Uncheck 'Plate with cover'.
Set Top Z-Position to Manual 20,000 microns.
Set Number of Flashes to 25.
Set Gain to Manual 100.
Set Integration time to 20 microseconds.

steps.title: Prepare Culture Samples
steps.instruction: Retrieve cultures from the incubator and homogenize them using aseptic technique in a sterile working area.

substeps.instruction: Pipette the sample up and down approximately 20 times using a 1000 microliter pipette.
Inspect the bottom of the flask to ensure no cells remain adhered to the surface.

steps.title: Aliquot Samples to Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized culture into a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Collect 250 microliters of culture.
Transfer to a designated well in the 96-well plate, ensuring no bubbles are present in the sample.

steps.title: Load Plate into Reader
steps.instruction: Insert the sample plate into the Tecan Infinite M200 Pro.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate lid.
Push the triangular button on top of the box to open the door.
Place the tray inside.
Press the button again to retract the tray and close the door.

steps.title: Run Measurement
steps.instruction: Initiate the reading process by clicking the 'Start' button at the top of the software screen.

steps.title: Save and Export Data
steps.instruction: Manage the resulting measurement data generated in the automatically appearing Excel sheet.

substeps.instruction: Save the data in the Correa Lab directory.
For multiple samples, either keep the sheet open to add new tabs or generate a new document for each sample.

steps.title: Archive and Organize Data
steps.instruction: Upload the day's data to the cloud (e.g., Samantha's shared OneDrive folder).

substeps.instruction: Organize files by growth curve/project and date.
Maintain a summary of daily measurements in a master excel sheet and/or lab notebook.
